top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Policy paper: UK – U.S. Financial Regulatory Working Group Summer 2026: Joint Statement
top_signals.summary: HM Treasury and U.S. Treasury Joint Statement on the 13th official meeting of the UK – U.S. Financial Regulatory Working Group.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Correspondence: Chancellor letter to the Treasury Select Committee (TSC) - Budget 2026 date
top_signals.summary: The Chancellor has today written to the Treasury Select Committee (TSC) to confirm the date of the budget.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Rheinmetall Cuts Outlook After Losing Out on Naval Contract
top_signals.summary: Rheinmetall AG cut its sales forecast for this year as Germany’s biggest defense company deals with the fallout of losing a German naval contract worth several billion euros.
